dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments decoded as latin-1.
evidence: COPY directives for ORCA-specific copybooks (MCPAREA, CPPTINF.INC, CPHKNNUM.INC, etc.)
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (Rezept) processing — patient self-pay amount determination check subprogram for the JMA ORCA medical billing system
purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCSFTNJGNCHK) performs self-pay amount (patient co-payment) determination checks for medical insurance receipts in the JMA ORCA system. It validates patient insurance information, calculates co-payment amounts based on income level, age, and regional public subsidy rules, and returns result codes to the caller. The extensive revision history shows ongoing updates for regional public expense (Chihou Kouhi) rules across many Japanese prefectures.

notable_features: 26 CALL statements to other ORCA subprograms
LINKAGE SECTION with parameter area (ORCSFTNJGNCHKAREA) and SPA-AREA
Japanese EUC-JP comments (rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
OCCURS 50 table for insurance combination numbers
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP encoding, appearing as mojibake. This is definitively part of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software system. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 146118 bytes total.
